Package com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.in

Record Class KfeProofOfReservesService.SolvencySnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.in.KfeProofOfReservesService.SolvencySnapshot
Record Components:
totalLiabilitiesSats - all liability buckets used by policy
customerLiabilitiesSats - customer balance liabilities
systemProfitSats - profit liability pending segregation/reconciliation
inFlightWithdrawalSats - outstanding withdrawal liability
eligibleAssetsSats - confirmed assets accepted by the solvency policy
onchainReserveAssetsSats - on-chain portion of the eligible assets
lightningReserveAssetsSats - Lightning portion of the eligible assets
safetyBufferSats - required safety margin in satoshis
coverageRatio - eligible assets divided by total liabilities, as evaluated by policy
minimumCoverageRatio - configured minimum coverage threshold
solvent - whether policy requirements are satisfied
snapshotBlockHash - external block/hash marker for the asset observation
snapshotAt - time at which this result was evaluated
Enclosing class:
KfeProofOfReservesService
public static record KfeProofOfReservesService.SolvencySnapshot(long totalLiabilitiesSats, long customerLiabilitiesSats, long systemProfitSats, long inFlightWithdrawalSats, long eligibleAssetsSats, long onchainReserveAssetsSats, long lightningReserveAssetsSats, long safetyBufferSats, double coverageRatio, double minimumCoverageRatio, boolean solvent, String snapshotBlockHash, Instant snapshotAt) extends Record
Immutable solvency snapshot at a point in time.

  • Method Details

    • equitySats

      public long equitySats()
      Calculates assets minus liabilities using overflow-safe subtraction.
      Returns:
      equity in satoshis; negative values indicate liabilities exceed assets
      Throws:
      ArithmeticException - if subtraction overflows

    • status

      public String status()
      Classifies the snapshot using empty, solvent, insolvent, and near-insolvent thresholds.
      Returns:
      UNKNOWN, SOLVENT, INSOLVENT, or NEAR_INSOLVENT
      Throws:
      ArithmeticException - if total liabilities plus safety buffer overflows
